title: AWL 学术词汇
subtitle: 源自 Academic Word List（Averil Coxhead），北美大学英语教学广泛使用的 570 学术词族

defsEn: v consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
v break down into components or essential features
v make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of
break down into components or essential features
v subject to psychoanalytic treatment
zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解
examples: You cannot analyse the data efficiently unless you draw a plot.
Analyses of individual events abstracted from their historical context often come to erroneous conclusions.

defsEn: n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something
n. the event of one object coming closer to another
n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
zh: n. 接近, 入门
vt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量
vi. 靠近
examples: With the approach of Christmas, business improved somewhat.
I approach every situation with an open mind.
exampleZh: 圣诞节快到了，生意也好了点。

defsEn: n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
n. a subject of study
n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
n. a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function
zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地
examples: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
This area is famous for its handcraft business.
exampleZh: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。
该地区因它的手工业而出名。

defsEn: v. charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine
v. estimate the value of (property) for taxation
zh: vt. 估定, 对...征税, 评定
examples: Assess people, not based on their appearance, but on their behavior.
Assess people, not based on their appearance, but on their behaviour.

defsEn: v. take to be the case or to be true
accept without verification or proof
v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
v. take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect
v. occupy or take on
zh: vt. 假定, 承担, 呈现
vi. 装腔作势, 僭越
examples: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
exampleZh: 我想你不会那么做的吧。
她以为所有人都会赞成计划。

defsEn: n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions
n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
n. an expert whose views are taken as definitive
n. official permission or approval
zh: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家
examples: He gave me authority to fire them.
On what authority are you making us go?
exampleZh: 他授权给我解雇了他们。
凭什么让我们走？

defsEn: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
s. not busy
not otherwise committed
s. convenient for use or disposal
zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的
examples: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
He wouldn't be available until four.
exampleZh: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。
他到了四时以后才有空。

defsEn: n. financial assistance in time of need
n. something that aids or promotes well-being
n. a performance to raise money for a charitable cause
v. be beneficial for
zh: n. 利益
vt. 有益于
vi. 受益
examples: The benefit will in any case be significant.
She would benefit from a visit.

defsEn: n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
zh: n. 观念, 概念
examples: The concept of family is both foreign and intriguing to me.
The concept of race has no basis in biology.

defsEn: v. have its essential character
be comprised or contained in
be embodied in
v. be consistent in form, tenor, or character
be congruous
v. be composed of
zh: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
examples: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
The Beatles consisted of four musicians.
exampleZh: 他的薪水包括基本工资和提成。
The Beatles 由四个音乐家组成。

defsEn: v. form or compose
zh: vt. 构成, 组成, 任命
examples: Fungi constitute a completely independent kingdom of life.
He was constituted representative of the party.

defsEn: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
zh: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉
n. 上下文
examples: There's no context for any of this.
The context influences the perception of truth.

defsEn: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
n. (contract bridge) the highest bid becomes the contract setting the number of tricks that the bidder must make
n. a variety of bridge in which the bidder receives points toward game only for the number of tricks he bid
v. enter into a contractual arrangement
zh: n. 合约, 婚约, 契约
vt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结
vi. 皱缩, 订约, 收缩
examples: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.
The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
exampleZh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

defsEn: v. bring into existence
v. pursue a creative activity
be engaged in a creative activity
v. invest with a new title, office, or rank
v. create by artistic means
zh: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
examples: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
I created an archive of my emails.
exampleZh: 我在桌面上建了一个快捷方式。
我给自己的邮件做了一份档案。

defsEn: n. a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn
zh: pl. 资料, 数据
examples: With data, he's a genius. But with code -- complete numbskull.
This data isn't accurate at all.
exampleZh: 在处理资料上，他很有天赋。但编写代码的话，只能说一窍不通。
这个数据一点也不准确。

defsEn: v. give a definition for the meaning of a word
v. determine the nature of
v. show the form or outline of
zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
examples: How would you define a successful marriage?
Could you define the word and say what you understand by it?

defsEn: v. obtain
v. come from
v. develop or evolve from a latent or potential state
be connected by a relationship of blood, for example
zh: vt. 得自
vi. 起源
examples: We derive further pleasure from our study.
He derived a lot of profit from the enterprise.

defsEn: v. administer or bestow, as in small portions
v. make available
v. give to several people
v. spread throughout a given area
zh: vt. 分配, 散布, 分发
examples: How to distribute abundance is a great problem.
He distributed new textbooks to the class.

defsEn: n. the system of production and distribution and consumption
n. the efficient use of resources
n. frugality in the expenditure of money or resources
n. an act of economizing
reduction in cost
zh: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
examples: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
Japan has an economy that is supported by hard-working company employees in big cities.
exampleZh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
日本的经济是由一群勤奋工作的大城市上班族支撑起的。

defsEn: n. the totality of surrounding conditions
n. the area in which something exists or lives
zh: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕
examples: The environment benefits from every small effort we make.
In the US, the environment is hostile to Islam.

defsEn: v. set up or found
v. set up or lay the groundwork for
v. bring about
v. use as a basis for
found on
zh: vt. 建立, 确立, 制定
vi. 移植生长
examples: You establish the property right by paying for it.
They were established to celebrate a certain event or to tell an age-old legend.

defsEn: n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth
n. a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody
n. a statement indicating the likely cost of some job
n. the respect with which a person is held
zh: n. 估计, 判断
vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
vi. 估计
examples: We estimate that we could be there in a fortnight.
This estimate should be pretty accurate.

defsEn: s clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
s capable of being seen or noticed
zh: a. 显然的, 明显的
examples: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
It is evident that he has made a mistake.
exampleZh: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
很明显的是他犯了错。

defsEn: n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country
v. sell or transfer abroad
v. transfer (electronic data) out of a database or document in a format that can be used by other programs
v. cause to spread in another part of the world
zh: n. 输出品, 输出
vt. 输出, 出口
vi. 输出物资
examples: Export of the product will start soon.
We export a lot of automobiles to that country.

defsEn: n. anything that contributes causally to a result
n. any of the numbers (or symbols) that form a product when multiplied together
n. an independent variable in statistics
v. resolve into factors
zh: n. 因素, 因数, 系数, 基因, 代理人
examples: The two factors need to balance each other out.
Factories can boost female employment in India.

defsEn: n. the commercial activity of providing funds and capital
n. the branch of economics that studies the management of money and other assets
n. the management of money and credit and banking and investments
v. obtain or provide money for
zh: n. 财政, 财务
vt. 供给...经费, 负担经费
vi. 筹措资金
examples: Finance is a branch of economics.
Finance Ministry officials tried to boost confidence in recovery.

defsEn: n. a group of symbols that make a mathematical statement
n. a conventionalized statement expressing some fundamental principle
n. a representation of a substance using symbols for its constituent elements
n. a liquid food for infants
zh: n. 客套语, 公式, 准则
examples: A formula is very convenient, because you need not think about it.
This formula is the basis of the theory.

defsEn: n. (mathematics) a mathematical relation such that each element of a given set (the domain of the function) is associated with an element of another set (the range of the function)
n. what something is used for
n. the actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
n. a relation such that one thing is dependent on another
zh: n. 官能, 职务, 功能, 函数
vi. 活动, 运行, 行使职责
examples: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
A quadratic function cannot be used here.
exampleZh: 刹车的功能是使车停下。
二次函数在这里是不可用的。

defsEn: v. recognize as being
establish the identity of someone or something
v. consider (oneself) as similar to somebody else
v. conceive of as united or associated
v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与
vi. 一致, 认同
examples: She identified him as the murderer.
To identify and verify your YubiKey, please enter a token in the field below.
exampleZh: 她确认他是杀人凶手。

defsEn: n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
zh: n. 收入, 收益, 流入
examples: My income is a far cry from his.
His income was diminished by half after retirement.
exampleZh: 我的工资比他少多了。
退休后他的收入少了一半。

defsEn: v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing
either spatially or figuratively
v. to state or express briefly
v. suggest the necessity of an intervention
in medicine
zh: vt. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出
examples: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.
Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
exampleZh: 我将他的缺席视为没有兴趣。
她脸上的笑容，代表她已经原谅我了。

defsEn: n. a single organism
a. being or characteristic of a single thing or person
s. separate and distinct from others of the same kind
s. characteristic of or meant for a single person or thing
zh: n. 人, 个人, 个体
a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
examples: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
She had an individual style of speaking.
exampleZh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
她说话有自己的风格。

defsEn: v. make sense of
assign a meaning to
v. give an interpretation or rendition of
zh: vt. 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解
vi. 翻译, 解释
examples: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
How would you interpret this passage?
exampleZh: 我认为她的沉默就是表示拒绝。

defsEn: v. connect closely and often incriminatingly
v. engage as a participant
v. contain as a part
v. occupy or engage the interest of
zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
examples: We got involved in a traffic accident.
He was involved in the trouble.
exampleZh: 我们被卷入了一场交通事故。
他被卷进了是非中。

defsEn: n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
n. one of a series published periodically
n. the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)
n. supplies (as food or clothing or ammunition) issued by the government
zh: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端
vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下
vt. 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
examples: This issue has nothing to do with you.
Don't dodge the issue, I want you to answer my question.
exampleZh: 这件事与你无关。
不要逃避，我要你回答我的问题。

defsEn: n a social class comprising those who do manual labor or work for wages
n concluding state of pregnancy
from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
n a political party formed in Great Britain in 1900
characterized by the promotion of labor's interests and formerly the socialization of key industries
n productive work (especially physical work done for wages)
v work hard
v strive and make an effort to reach a goal
v undergo the efforts of childbirth
zh: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩
vi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干
vt. 详细分析, 使厌烦
examples: He laboured to restrain his desire to speak.
There are labours which no salary can remunerate, services which no fees can requite.

defsEn: a. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules
a. of or relating to jurisprudence
s. having legal efficacy or force
a. relating to or characteristic of the profession of law
zh: a. 法律的, 法定的, 合法的
examples: Seashells were the legal tender in the Shang dynasty.
Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
exampleZh: 在商朝，贝朋为通用货币。
法律架构的存在，使战争罪犯的责任可以追究。

defsEn: v. make laws, bills, etc. or bring into effect by legislation
zh: vi. 制定法律
vt. 用立法规定
examples: It's not possible to legislate against stupidity.

defsEn: n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines
below lieutenant colonel and above captain
n. British statesman who was prime minister from 1990 until 1997 (born in 1943)
n. a university student who is studying a particular field as the principal subject
n. the principal field of study of a student at a university
zh: n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
vi. 主修
examples: I majored in philosophy at my university.
I majored in American literature at college.
exampleZh: 我在大学主修哲学。
我在大学主修美国文学。

defsEn: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way
implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
zh: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序
examples: Your method is different from mine.
This method is sure to work.
exampleZh: 你的方法和我的不一样。
这个方法一定会成功。

defsEn: v. come to one's mind
suggest itself
v. to be found to exist
zh: vi. 发生, 被想到, 存在
examples: It occurred to me that he might be in the library.
It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
exampleZh: 我突然想到，他可能在图书馆 。
我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。

defsEn: n a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
zh: n. 百分比, 百分数, 部分
examples: Over ten percent of them can do the work.
Ninety percent of the time he will come.

defsEn: n. the interval taken to complete one cycle of a regularly repeating phenomenon
n. (ice hockey) one of three divisions into which play is divided in hockey games
n. a unit of geological time during which a system of rocks formed
n. the end or completion of something
zh: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期
a. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的
interj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
examples: The registration period is already over.
In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
exampleZh: 报名时间已经过了。
在江户时代赏月的宴会非常受欢迎。

defsEn: n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government
n. written contract or certificate of insurance
zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单
examples: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
The policy fluctuated between two opinions.
exampleZh: 这个政策导致物价大幅度的上升。
该政策在两种意见之间摇摆。

defsEn: n. a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct
n. a rule or standard especially of good behavior
n. a basic truth or law or assumption
n. a rule or law concerning a natural phenomenon or the function of a complex system
zh: n. 原则, 原理, 主义
examples: He sold his principles for money.
The principle underlying democracy is the division of power.
exampleZh: 他为了钱抛弃自己的原则。

defsEn: v. move ahead
travel onward in time or space
v. follow a certain course
zh: vi. 继续进行, 进行, 开始, 发出, 起诉
examples: Proceed strongly in the matter, but gently in the method!
The proceeds from the bond issue will be used to finance the budget deficit.

zh: （技术）处理
examples: Once this process is started, we can get the result within one hour.
This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
exampleZh: 这个进程一旦开始，我们能在一小时内得到结果。
这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。

defsEn: v require as useful, just, or proper
v consider obligatory
request and expect
v make someone do something
v have need of
zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
examples: I require a few clothes hangers.
They require me to work harder.
exampleZh: 我需要几个衣架。
他们要求我更努力地工作。

defsEn: n. systematic investigation to establish facts
v. attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner
v. inquire into
zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查
examples: He researched British tea culture in great detail.
Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
exampleZh: 他对英国茶文化很有研究。
有关癌症成因的研究耗费颇巨。

defsEn: v. respond favorably or as hoped
zh: vt. 以...回答
vi. 回答, 响应, 回报, 有反应, 承担责任
examples: He didn't respond to my question.
He responded kindly to the question.
exampleZh: 他没有回答我的问题。
他亲切地回答了问题。

defsEn: n. normal or customary activity of a person in a particular social setting
zh: n. 角色, 职责, 任务
examples: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
What role can the internet play in education?
exampleZh: 胎盘的角色是滋养胎儿。

defsEn: n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)
n. a very thin slice (of tissue or mineral or other substance) for examination under a microscope
n. a distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people
n. one of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object
zh: n. 区段, 部分, 区域, 节, 截面, 处, 科, 区, 扇区
vt. 把...分段, 把...切片
vi. 被切成片
examples: There are seven men and four women in my section.
The woodwind section includes both pipes and reeds.
exampleZh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。
木管乐器组中包含无簧片管乐器与簧片管乐器。

defsEn: n. a plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle
n. a social group that forms part of the society or the economy
n. a particular aspect of life or activity
n. the minimum track length that can be assigned to store information
unless otherwise specified a sector of data consists of 512 bytes
zh: n. 扇形, 部门, 部分, 函数尺, 象限仪, 段, 区段
vt. 把...分成扇形
examples: The manufacturing sector is the most diverse in the Eastern Caribbean area.
The manufacturing sector is a frenzy over the new monetary policy.

defsEn: a. important in effect or meaning
s. fairly large
a. too closely correlated to be attributed to chance and therefore indicating a systematic relation
zh: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含义的, 暗示的, 值得注意的
examples: My significant other and I often go bowling.
A significant amount was provided for national defense.

defsEn: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance
s. (of words) expressing closely related meanings
zh: a. 相似的, 类似的
n. 相似的东西
examples: He became similar to us, through Jesus Christ, the eternal Son of God.
We are so similar and so different at the same time.

defsEn: n. a document (or organization) from which information is obtained
n. anything that provides inspiration for later work
n. a facility where something is available
n. (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system
zh: n. 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源
examples: The source of many of our mistakes is a lack of patience.
What is your greatest source of inspiration?
exampleZh: 许多错误源自于我们缺乏耐心。
什么是您最大的灵感来源？

defsEn: n. a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease
a. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
s. stated explicitly or in detail
a. relating to or distinguishing or constituting a taxonomic species
zh: n. 特效药, 特性
a. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
examples: Is there a specific time for your bus?
Is there a specific purpose to life?

defsEn: n. a thing constructed
a complex entity constructed of many parts
n. the manner of construction of something and the arrangement of its parts
n. the complex composition of knowledge as elements and their combinations
n. a particular complex anatomical part of a living thing
zh: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物
vt. 构成, 组织
examples: The structure of the brain is complicated.
The structure of the human body can be thought of in the same way.
exampleZh: 头脑的结构很复杂。

defsEn: n. a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world
an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena
n. a belief that can guide behavior
zh: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测
examples: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
exampleZh: 理论得联系实际。
这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

defsEn: v. be subject to change in accordance with a variable
v. make something more diverse and varied
zh: vt. 改变, 使多样化
vi. 变化, 有不同, 违反
examples: Vary your cardio exercises to keep it interesting.
Karlovy Vary is famous for its hot springs.

defsEn: s. nearest in space or position
immediately adjoining without intervening space
s. having a common boundary or edge
abutting
touching
Massachusetts and Conncecticut"
s. near or close to but not necessarily touching
zh: a. 毗连的, 邻近的, 连接的
examples: Adjacent to the main campus is an outdoor education area, a natural reserve.
I was emo-adjacent in high school.

defsEn: conj. Even though
although
notwithstanding.
zh: conj. 尽管, 虽然
examples: Tom hopes to make a profit this year, albeit a small one.
Ziri is not bad at all, albeit a little on the boring side.

defsEn: v. create by putting components or members together
v. get people together
zh: vt. 集合, 收集, 装配
vi. 集合
examples: Assemble the towel rack before you install it.

Exposed to water, wood will ultimately fall into decay.

画质真的很差 - 分辨率那么低。

defsEn: n. a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties

v. cause to point

Refined sugar is bad for your health.

defsEn: v. become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
v. make less taut
v. cause to feel relaxed
v. become less tense, less formal, or less restrained, and assume a friendlier manner
zh: vi. 放松, 松懈, 松弛, 变从容, 休息, 休养
vt. 使松弛, 缓和, 使松懈, 使休息
examples: I relax while listening to classical music.
I relaxed at home last Sunday.
exampleZh: 我放松时会听古典乐。
我上个星期天在家里放轻松。

defsEn: v. keep under control
keep in check
v. to close within bounds, limit or hold back from movement
v. hold back
zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束缚
examples: He could not restrain his excitement.
I told Jim to restrain himself from drinking too much.

defsEn: n. a drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving
n. the overthrow of a government by those who are governed
zh: n. 革命, 大变革, 旋转, 转数, 循环
examples: A revolution is not a dinner party.
The revolution ushered in a new era.
exampleZh: 革命不是请客吃饭。
革命迎来了新时代。

defsEn: s. incapable of or resistant to bending
s. incapable of compromise or flexibility
a. designating an airship or dirigible having a form maintained by a stiff unyielding frame or structure
zh: a. 坚硬的, 刚性的, 严格的, 精密的, 刻板的
examples: I was brought up under rigid discipline.
Rigid wheels give sufficient stability to a low-speed vehicle steered by outside forces.

defsEn: v. send documents or materials to appropriate destinations
v. send via a specific route
v. divert in a specified direction
zh: n. 路径, 途径, 路线
vt. 确定路线, 按规定路线发送
examples: This route will lead you to the station.
This route will take you to the station.

defsEn: n. an outline or synopsis of a play (or, by extension, of a literary work)
n. a setting for a work of art or literature
n. a postulated sequence of possible events
zh: n. 剧本提纲, 情节, 剧本, 方案, 事态
examples: You should always plan for the worst-case scenario.
The worst-case scenario may not be the most likely, but it can always happen.

defsEn: n. a particular environment or walk of life
n. any spherically shaped artifact
n. the geographical area in which one nation is very influential
n. a solid figure bounded by a spherical surface (including the space it encloses)
zh: n. 球, 球面, 球体, 天体, 地球仪, 范围
vt. 包围, 使成球体, 放入球内
examples: Our sphere of influence has expanded so much since then.
The highest sphere of life is mathematics.

defsEn: n. an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
v. rank or order as less important or consider of less value
v. make subordinate, dependent, or subservient
a. lower in rank or importance
zh: n. 属下, 附属物
a. 下级的, 次要的, 附属的
vt. 使居下位, 使服从
examples: Can you describe the ideal supervisor-subordinate relationship?
He is able to subordinate passion to reason.

defsEn: n. a quantity added (e.g. to make up for a deficiency)
v. add as a supplement to what seems insufficient
v. serve as a supplement to
zh: n. 补充物, 增刊, 补充, 补遗, 补编, 附录, 补角
vt. 补充, 增补
examples: He supplemented his lecture with a booklet.
To supplement its income, the hardware store sold parts for wagons and carriages.

defsEn: v. hang freely
v. cause to be held in suspension in a fluid
v. bar temporarily
from school, office, etc.
v. make inoperative or stop
zh: vt. 悬, 吊, 使悬浮, 暂停, 中止, 推迟
vi. 暂停, 中止, 悬浮, 停止偿付债务
examples: He was suspended from school for a week for bad conduct.
Suspending the trial is out of the question.

defsEn: n. a cooperative unit (especially in sports)
n. two or more draft animals that work together to pull something
v. form a team
zh: n. 队, 组
vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
examples: Which team do you think will win?
Which team are you a fan of?
exampleZh: 你觉得哪支球队会赢？
你是哪一队的迷?

defsEn: n a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis
a not permanent
not lasting
s lacking continuity or regularity
zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的
n. 临时工, 临时雇员
examples: How temporary will this situation be?
A temporary stage was set up in the park.

defsEn: n. a device that activates or releases or causes something to happen
n. an act that sets in motion some course of events
v. release or pull the trigger on
zh: n. 触发器, 扳机
vt. 触发, 发射, 引起
vi. 松开扳柄
examples: What triggers this type of anxiety?
What triggers a cat's aggressive behavior?

defsEn: v. become one
zh: v. 统一, 使成一体
examples: Why did they unify their development tools?
Algeria has a unified national healthcare system.

defsEn: v. fail to agree with
be in violation of
as of rules or patterns
v. destroy
zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍
examples: If you violate the terms of service, your account will be suspended.
They violated the terms of the contract.

defsEn: n. a vivid mental image
n. the perceptual experience of seeing
n. a religious or mystical experience of a supernatural appearance
zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想
vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
examples: My vision is getting worse these days.
He told us that visions would appear to him during the night.
exampleZh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
